title: Boj qanday hisoblanadi — 5 qadam
caption: 🧮 Boj qanday hisoblanadi: 5 qadam Misol: kuryer orqali 700 $ lik noutbuk, og'irligi 2,5 kg, yo'l harajati 23,75 $. Shu oyda boshqa posilka yo'q. 1️⃣ Bojxona qiymati (tovar + yo'l): 700 + 23,75 = 723,75 $. Normani ayiring: − 200 = 523,75 $ 2️⃣ Foizni qo'llang. Yagona bojxona to'lovi — 30 %: 523,75 × 30 % = 157,13 $ 3️⃣ Minimalni tekshiring. 1 kg uchun kamida 3 $: 2,5 × 3 = 7,5 $. Foiz bo'yicha summa katta — 157,13 $ to'lanadi 4️⃣ So'mga o'giring: 157,13 × 11 772,95 = 1 849 884 so'm 5️⃣ Yig'imni qo'shing. 1 ta BKO (bojxona kirim orderi) uchun — BHM ning 25 %: 440 000 × 25 % = 110 000 so'm 💰 Jami: 1 959 884 so'm 📅 2027-yil 1-yanvardan stavka 20 %: 523,75 × 20 % = 104,75 $ — 52,38 $ tejaladi. ⚠️ Hisob taxminiy: yakuniy summani bojxona organi tovarning bojxona qiymati asosida belgilaydi. 📄 Asos: PQ-4508, 3-band; PF-174, V bo'lim 8-band; VM 244-son; VM 55-son, 31.01.2025 — lex.uz 💬 Murakkab holat bo'lsa — maslahat oling ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #boj
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#boj".
2) Center: a matte white calculator next to a closed laptop resting on a cardboard parcel; five small numbered indigo steps (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) rise like a staircase beside them. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of emerald green (#059669); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Boj qanday hisoblanadi"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "5 qadamda"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: Bojxona qiymati = tovar + yetkazish (yo'l harajati) — muallif tasdiqladi, 05.10.2026. Yo'l: 2,5 kg × 9,50 $ = 23,75 $. 5-QADAM LEX.UZ DA TASDIQLANMADI (lex.uz Claude muhitidan ochilmadi): 1 ta BKO uchun yig'im — BHM ning 25 % (muallif so'rovi, stavka qidiruv natijalaridan) va BHM 440 000 so'm — yangilik saytlaridan. Tasdiqlashdan oldin VM 55-son qarorida tekshiring.
